sentences.text: Estimates based on the known remains suggest this dinosaur was 15 to 18 meters long and weighed around 7 metric tons.
The dorsal vertebrae feature an opisthocoelous centrum and large lateral pleurocoels, which are pneumatic depressions.
A potentially diagnostic parapophysis ridge is present on one vertebra, though poor preservation prevents its identification on others.
Andesaurus was named in 1991 by paleontologists Jorge Orlando Calvo and José Fernando Bonaparte.
The only known species, A. delgadoi, is named after Alejandro Delgado, who discovered the fossils.
Andesaurus shared its environment with theropods like Buitreraptor and Giganotosaurus, as well as the sauropod Limaysaurus.
Andesaurus is characterized as the most basal known member of the clade Titanosauria due to several primitive features.
Unlike derived titanosaurs with ball-and-socket tail joints, Andesaurus has flat-ended (amphiplatyan) tail vertebrae similar to non-titanosaurian sauropods.
Andesaurus belongs to the parent group Titanosauria.
Andesaurus is classified in the class Saurischia.
Andesaurus lived in an environment that was an ancient braided river system.
The Paleobiology Database lists the time range for Andesaurus as the Albian, from 113.2 to 110.1 million years ago.
